name: W139
funFact: Artists squatted this former theatre in1979 and turned it into an artist-run space for experimental contemporary art. Its four-storey neoclassical street front was restored in2006–07 after being reduced to two floors in1958.
description: W139 occupies a restored historic complex behind Warmoesstraat139. The former theatre and sociëteit De Vereeniging were once used by Amsterdam’s securities traders; today artists develop ambitious exhibitions here.
